linework.observation: Strong clean outlines define the seated protagonist, ladder, desk, pipes and instruments.

colour.observation: Muted navy and gray balance the warm lamp; the cool exterior opening adds a distracting blue region.

shading.observation: Soft cel shading and illustrated steel bands match the canonical rendering.

character_construction.observation: The bald protagonist’s head and facial features match the identity sheet; body shape and pose are coherent.

backgrounds.observation: The work nook has a chart table, ladder, gauges and steel bulkhead; the circular opening shows an implausible exterior view.

finish.observation: Polished image with clear focal detail and no apparent technical artifacts.

identity.observation: Bald protagonist and navy coveralls remain consistent.

content.observation: FAIL: a large circular opening reveals blue sky or water inside the submarine work area.

composition.observation: Medium-wide seated pose keeps the protagonist’s full body visible with clear headroom and surrounding workspace.

regions.people_faces: One bald protagonist writing in a notebook, focused and tired.
regions.foreground_props: Notebook, pencil, mug, folded chart and equipment case.
regions.architecture: Ladder and pipework frame the work nook; circular exterior opening is inaccurate.
regions.distance: Ladder and equipment recede behind the character.
regions.lighting: Warm caged lamp with cool daylight from the opening; remove the outside source.

correction: Keep the protagonist writing the watch log in the same compact work nook. Replace the round exterior opening with a sealed steel access hatch or solid bulkhead; show no sky or water. Preserve the ladder, chart, notebook, bald identity, coveralls and muted cel-shaded style.
